servicesList.name: Digital Orbit Package
servicesList.description: A package designed for launches that includes cover and mockup, an animated video, a GIF element, a premium version testimonial, and 5 hours of specialized consulting.

servicesList.name: Professional Pro Package
servicesList.description: Designed for content creators and online courses. Offers 5 premium resources: cover design, mockup, an animated video, a carousel template, and a testimonial.

servicesList.name: Creative Boost Package
servicesList.description: Ideal for boosting personal brands. Contains 5 key products: a detailed thumbnail, cover, intermediate image, carousel, and a testimonial.

servicesList.name: Digital Seed Package
servicesList.description: Excellent alternative for digital creators. Includes 5 essential elements: thumbnail, basic image design, featured image, simple testimonial, and 8 hours dedicated to design.

servicesList.name: Ad Carousel (6 images)
servicesList.description: A set of six images assembled with integrated text and a uniform visual structure, ready to be used in swipeable carousel formats.

servicesList.name: Testimonial – Advanced / Premium
servicesList.category: Reviews and testimonials integrated into design
servicesList.description: Creation of custom visual elements including direct animations in short video or GIF format. Offers 4 different formats and allows up to 6 revisions.

servicesList.name: Premium Digital/Interactive Book Cover
servicesList.description: Comprehensive design of your e-book in 3 parts: front, back, and spine. Delivered with custom illustrations and the possibility of multiple revisions.

servicesList.name: Basic Short Video Creative (10-30 sec)
servicesList.description: Simple production of short video clips (10-30 seconds). Includes animated text transitions, visual slides, and basic background music.

servicesList.name: Testimonial – Intermediate
servicesList.category: Reviews and testimonials integrated into design
servicesList.description: Visual enhancement of images with moderate photo editing. Delivers different variants including custom backgrounds, shadow effects, and more detailed compositions.

servicesList.name: E-book/Digital Book Cover (Front)
servicesList.description: Exclusive design of the front cover of your digital book. Focuses on clean aesthetics supported by good typography and balanced distribution of visual components.

servicesList.name: Advanced / Premium Thumbnail
servicesList.description: Detailed design of thumbnails for video platforms. Includes advanced photo retouching, lighting effects, and a graphic style that stands out to improve clicks.

servicesList.name: Advanced / Premium Ad Image
servicesList.description: Strategy and advertising image optimized for social media. Features high-quality visual elements and a design aimed at campaign conversion.

servicesList.name: Mockup Design
servicesList.description: Three-dimensional visual representation for your digital or physical products. Used to show how the product looks on screens, packaging, or real devices.

servicesList.name: Testimonial – Basic
servicesList.category: Reviews and testimonials integrated into design
servicesList.description: Basic and clean formatting of customer reviews or texts. Adapts to your brand's style so you can easily publish them on your website or social media.

servicesList.name: Basic Carousel Template
servicesList.description: Base structure for swipeable social media posts. Features simple visual guides so you can organize your content neatly.

servicesList.name: Intermediate Thumbnail
servicesList.description: Cover design for videos with a proper balance of texts and standard photo editing, ideal for keeping an active and organized channel.

servicesList.name: Intermediate Ad Image
servicesList.description: Design of advertising art with clear texts and balanced graphics, ready to be launched in digital commercial guidelines.

servicesList.name: Featured Image
servicesList.description: Main graphic design to use in the most important sections of your website, blogs, or highlighted press releases.

servicesList.name: Basic Thumbnail
servicesList.description: Basic assembly of covers for multimedia content using legible titles and straightforward backgrounds without complex photo compositions.

servicesList.name: Basic Ad Image
servicesList.description: Essential graphic design focused on a clear message for low-budget ads or quick social media campaigns.
